title: Keep a committed human decision attributed to its author
preconditions: A review has queue slide; Git users Dev and Other have distinct emails.

steps.action: Create a human approval and commit it with Git user Other; inspect its decision after Dev withdraws only Dev's own later decision.
steps.expected_result: Other's decision remains and the report identifies Other.

steps.action: Open the review as Dev and inspect the remaining decision author.
steps.expected_result: The UI identifies Other as the human who authored that decision.

expected_result: The UI identifies Other as the human who authored that decision.
